"I'll most likely aggregate rankings from a handful of sources, get the list into tiers, move a few guys up or down a tier if I have a take that's stronger or weaker than average, print it, and move on. Probably spend half an hour."

"Besides, if you are going into a draft solely focused on your rankings sheet, and not how best to apply *any* rankings sheet to your draft, you are going about it the wrong way. That's not how you win if your league is at all competent."

"Focus big picture, not small. What positions do I believe my league tends to overvalue? How many in the league have shown to be "not great" at drafting? I'm picking in X slot, if I do 20 mock drafts what do my teams tend to look like if I hammer this position early?"

"I'll tweak rankings here or there, often times due to knowing how my league mates value players rather than simply disagreeing with the rankings. But, like projections, there are easier ways to beat your opponents than having "more accurate rankings"."
